{{Quote|How could this happen? Last month, I was president of the Makeb Mining Concern. Today, I'm&hellip; I don't know what I am.|President of the Makeb Mining Concern|<ref name="Rise" />}}
The '''President of the Makeb Mining Concern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] president of the [[Makeb Mining Concern]], a business that conducted mining on [[Makeb]] before the [[Galactic War]] and the [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of Makeb by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The President was one of many Makeb residents who were dislocated due to the invasion.<ref name="Rise" />
